what: Per platform and flag: whether the feature is ON when its line is ABSENT from the running configuration (`state`), and whether the line ALONE makes it run on the interfaces (`runs_alone`). An absent line can mean 'on by default', not 'disabled'; a present line can enable nothing. Measured per platform, never assumed; a value not measured is 'not_measured', and nothing reads it as on, off, true or false (the rule of removal_measured.json).
how: On a device of the platform, read it with the tool's read-only probe, on the NMAS host as the service user: scripts/nmas-capture-output --device <name> --command 'show cdp' --command 'show cdp interface' --command 'show lldp' --command 'show lldp interface' --out /tmp/nmas-defaults . A capture taken while a deploy to that device is running measures the deploy, not the default. Each verdict names its device, its capture time and its fixture file under tests/fixtures/operational/platform_defaults/.

cdp run.evidence: s1 carries no `cdp run`; `show cdp` answers 'Global CDP information', and `show cdp interface` lists 6 of 6 interfaces sending CDP ('cdp enabled interfaces : 6')

lldp run.runs_alone_evidence: s3 carries `lldp run`, and `show lldp interface` lists every interface Tx and Rx enabled, with three neighbours
lldp run.measure_on: no device of this platform lacks `lldp run` today (s1-s4 all carry it), so its default cannot be measured on the current fleet

cdp run.evidence: r1 carries `cdp run`; `show cdp` answers 'Global CDP information', and `show cdp interface` answers 'cdp enabled interfaces : 0': on this platform `cdp run` alone enables no interface (each needs `cdp enable`). r6 read the same after its push
cdp run.measure_on: a C8000V whose configuration carries no `cdp run`, read when no deploy is running to it (r6's capture of 23:53:43 was taken DURING its push, whose first line was `cdp run`)

lldp run.runs_alone_evidence: after its push of `lldp run`, `show lldp interface` lists Gi1 and Gi2 Tx and Rx enabled
lldp run.measure_on: a C8000V whose configuration carries no `lldp run`, read when no deploy is running to it (r6's 'Status: ACTIVE' of 23:53:43 was taken DURING the push, whose second line was `lldp run`)
